name: Oat (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Oat (Avena sativa) [Cereals and cereal products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169705 (Oats, SR Legacy), proximates, amino acids, minerals, vitamins, fatty-acid classes
USDA / nutritionvalue.org NDB 57602100 (Oats, raw), selenium, vitamin E, vitamin K, total sugars
Yadessa et al. 2021, PMC8361264, oxalate, phytate, tannin, mineral ranges of oat grain
Alemayehu et al. 2023, The Scientific World Journal doi:10.1155/2023/2730175, starch fraction, free-sugar and beta-glucan composition
provenance.curation_notes: Oat is a starch-dominated dry cereal grain: the overwhelming carbon/energy source is starch (~58 g/100g, ~85% of carbohydrate), followed by beta-glucan (~4 g) and other fibre; free sugars are low (~1 g, mostly sucrose). Unlike fruit foods, oat has minimal free organic acids, oxalic and phytic acid are the only well-quantified ones. Protein is high (~17 g) and glutamate-rich. Removed four animal-derived metabolites (creatine, taurine, dopamine, serotonin) as biologically implausible FooDB noise;
curation_added: L-valine (essential AA absent from current profile)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
